title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s new Apple Watch Series 4 is all about your heart beat
text:
September 14, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s new Apple Watch Series 4 is all about your heart beat
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s new Apple Watch Series 4 will be able to tell about the cardiac issues, if your heart’s beating faster.
The innovative company’s latest Apple Watch packs reveals several new features, among which the most obvious change on its surface: a redesigned face to put much more screen on your wrist, it’s about time.
On Wednesday, the technology giant unveiled its new “Apple Watch Series 4” from the Steve Jobs Theater in its Apple Park headquarters. The device has a larger face, and it also features its own Electrocardiogram and Fall Detection. One can see new speakers added to new Apple Watch and a processor chip, that also boasts the much faster speeds for the watch.
